16.8 指示で守る境界と、応答時間の変数: 16.8 What instructions can and cannot bound, and what drives response time
3 層の設定は、Agent の振る舞いを決めます。ただし、決められるものと決めら: The three configuration layers decide how the Agent behaves. Some things they can decide, and some they cannot. Confuse the two and you end up with a restriction you believe you wrote down but that is not in force.
用語の解決、粒度の宣言、どのソースを既定にするか: Term resolution, grain declaration, which source is the default
利用者が元々アクセスできないデータを見せること: Showing data the user could not access in the first place
推論要求や境界外の問いを断り、理由を説明すること: Declining an inference request or an out-of-boundary question and explaining why
権限のないデータを「断ったことにする」こと: Turning unauthorised data into something that was merely refused
根拠の示し方、粒度と時間範囲の明示、単位の書き方: How evidence is shown, how grain and time range are declared, how units are written
行や列の可視範囲そのものを変えること: Changing which rows or columns are visible at all
アクセスはサインインした ID、参照元ソースの権限、および各アイテムが持つソース: Access follows the signed-in identity, the permissions on the underlying sources, and whatever source-side controls each item provides
指示が決めることと、決めないこと: What instructions decide, and what they do not
指示はアクセス制御ではありません。「この列は見せない」と書いても、権限上見えるデ: Instructions are not access control. Writing "do not show this column" does not make data that permissions allow disappear. What is actually visible follows the signed-in identity, the read permissions on the underlying sources, and the controls each item type provides on the source side. Do not assume row-level or column-level control is available in the same way on every source. Support differs by item type, so confirm it against the source pages in appendix E and against C.6.
指示は制御点ではない: Instructions are not a control point
第 5.1 節で managed Delta と対応条件を確認するのは、Onto: Section 5.1 checks managed Delta support because Ontology static bindings require managed Delta tables. OneLake Security restrictions in product documentation and the actual Workspace settings are separate concerns. Confirm the target Workspace settings with an administrator. Do not infer that OneLake Security is disabled from missing settings or successful import/refresh operations. This does not mean access controls are unnecessary in production. Define source-specific controls before sharing a Data Agent over real data; do not change security settings merely to make compatibility checks pass.
OneLake Security の製品条件と設定状態を確認する: Check OneLake Security product conditions and actual settings
応答時間も、設定によって変わります。ここでは秒数や倍率は示しません。環境と質問に: Response time also changes with configuration. No seconds or multipliers are given here: printing a value that varies by environment and question would itself become a false expectation. Only the direction is given.
選択したテーブル（とその全列）とエンティティが多いほど、解釈すべき候補が増える: The more selected tables (with all of their columns) and entities there are, the more candidates there are to interpret
答えるべき問いに必要な要素だけを選ぶ（第 16.2 節）: Select only the elements the intended questions need (section 16.2)
指示が長いほど、また矛盾する指示や例が混ざるほど、判断が重くなる: The longer the instructions, and the more contradictory instructions or examples are mixed in, the heavier the decision becomes
層ごとに抽象度を分け、重複と矛盾を減らす（第 16.1・16.6.1 節）: Separate the layers by level of abstraction and reduce duplication and contradiction (sections 16.1 and 16.6.1)
質問が曖昧なほど、また会話が長いほど、前提の確定に手数がかかる: The vaguer the question, and the longer the conversation, the more steps it takes to settle the assumptions
1 問 1 会話で実施し、指標と時間範囲を質問に含める（第 17 章）: Run one question per conversation and put the metric and the time range into the question (chapter 17)
生成されたクエリが重いほど、またデータモデルが複雑なほど時間がかかる: The heavier the generated query, and the more complex the data model, the longer it takes
集計済みの要素を使い、モデルの複雑さを下げる: Use pre-aggregated elements and lower the complexity of the model
容量が混雑しているほど、また 1 問で複数ソースを使うほど待ち時間が伸びる: The busier the capacity, and the more sources a single question uses, the longer the wait
ソース数を必要最小限にし、混雑時間帯を避けて実施する: Keep the number of sources to the minimum needed and avoid busy periods
応答時間に効く 5 つの変数（方向のみ、数値は示さない）: 5 variables behind response time (direction only, no figures)
消費の考え方は付録 C.6 にまとめてあります。ここでは繰り返しません。応答時間: Consumption is covered in appendix C.6 and is not repeated here. Response time and consumption are different subjects, but they move in the same direction on one point: the longer the instructions, examples and context, the higher both become.
17.12 実行証跡と、やり直す条件: 17.12 Execution evidence, and when to start over
第 17.11 節は「落ちたときにどの層から疑うか」でした。この節は、その判断を: Section 17.11 was about which layer to suspect when a question fails. This section decides where the evidence behind that judgement lives, and how far back you go to start over. There are three levels of evidence, and how far you can see differs by source.
合否への使い方: How it is used for the verdict
native 最終回答の全文、提示された数値、粒度と時間範囲の宣言、安定 ID、: The complete native final answer, figures presented, grain and time-range declarations, stable IDs, and refusal reasons
期待する結論に達しているか。境界を守っているか: Whether the expected conclusion was reached, and whether the boundary was respected
必須。要求された query・結果・ルートの証跡も併せて判定する: Required. Also assess the required query, result and routing evidence
全 analysis steps、使われたソース（ルート）、参照例、実際に実行し: All analysis steps, sources used (routes), referenced examples, every query actually executed and all returned results
正しいソース・query・結果に基づくか。最終回答に必須項目が残っているか: Whether the answer uses the correct sources, queries and results, and retains all mandatory fields in the final answer
必須。未取得や途中で切れた証跡を成功と扱わない: Required. Missing or truncated evidence is not success
そのエンジンに残る実行の記録: The record of execution kept by that engine
実際に到達して実行されたか。失敗がエンジン側かどうか: Whether it actually reached the engine and ran, and whether a failure was engine-side
見られる場合のみ補助として使う。合格の必須条件にはしない: Use it as support only where it is visible. It is never a condition for a pass
判定に使う 3 段階の証跡: The three levels of evidence used for a verdict
エンジン側の実行履歴をどこまで見られるかは、ソースの種類と権限によって違います。: Visibility of engine-side execution history varies by source and permission. Unavailable engine history for a source does not itself fail a question. Do not copy query text into the record sheet's answer field. This does not mean discarding evidence: separately from the answer summary, privately preserve every actual query, all returned results, analysis steps and the complete native final answer, with references from the record. Preserving execution evidence is different from copying held-out questions or expected answers into Agent instructions or examples. The latter is forbidden. Optional engine history does not waive failure to capture required native evidence.
回答の要約と非公開の完全な実行証跡を分ける: Separate the answer summary from complete private execution evidence
MCP 経由でも公開済み Agent の最終回答を保存して比較できます。ただし、: You can preserve and compare a published Agent's final answers through MCP. However, when the reply contains only answer text and `isError`, internal SQL/KQL/GQL, returned rows, and backend conversation IDs are unobserved. Do not substitute source claims or tables in the answer, or client-side RPC IDs, for execution evidence. Report conditions verifiable from the text as PASS/FAIL/NA separately from unmet native-evidence gates. Zero strict passes caused by missing evidence does not mean 0% factual-answer accuracy. Do not relax the original ten questions, 84 requirements, or acceptance gates: complete quality acceptance remains pending until the required execution details are available. Base improvements on observed omissions or contradictions in the answer, not on imagined defects in unseen queries.
MCP の回答比較と完全な native 受入を分ける: Separate MCP answer comparison from complete native acceptance
落ちた問いは、証跡のどこが期待と違ったかで、直す場所が決まります。この順序は第: For a failed question, where the evidence diverged from the expectation decides where to fix it. This ordering follows the same thinking as the configuration layers in section 17.11, seen from the evidence side.
ルートが違う（別のソースが使われた）: The route is wrong (a different source was used)
ソース説明と、第 16.2 節のソース選択: The source descriptions and the source selection in section 16.2
説明に「何を持たないか」を足し、選択した要素が意図どおりかを数え直す: Add what the source does not hold to its description, and recount whether the selected elements are what you intended
ソースは正しいがクエリが違う: The source is right but the query is wrong
参照された例クエリ、ソース指示、絞り込みの条件: The example queries retrieved, the source instructions, the filter conditions
引かれた例が意図と合っているかを見て、列・集計・スコープの規則を具体化する: Check whether the retrieved example matches the intent, then make the column, aggregation and scope rules concrete
エンジン側で失敗した: It failed on the engine side
エラー本文、接続先、実行権限、構成、サービス状態: Error text, connection target, execution permissions, configuration, and service status
EXECUTION_ERROR として扱い、第 17.11 節の再実行・切り分け: Treat it as EXECUTION_ERROR and follow the retry and investigation procedure in section 17.11
クエリは正しいが回答が不足している: The query is right but the answer is incomplete
グローバル指示の回答形式の規則: The answer-format rules in the global instructions
粒度・時間範囲・安定 ID・単位の示し方を回答形式の規則として補う: Add how grain, time range, stable IDs and units are presented as answer-format rules
証跡から直す場所を決める: Deciding where to fix from the evidence
第 17.11 節の規則は「設定を変更したら 10 問すべてをやり直す」でした。: The rule in section 17.11 was to rerun all ten questions after any configuration change. This section does not weaken it. It keeps the same strength and lists the triggers other than a change.
3 層の設定または例クエリの変更: A change to the three configuration layers or to the example queries
解釈・ルーティング・クエリの形: Interpretation, routing, the shape of the query
選択したスキーマまたはソース構成の変更: A change to the selected schema or to the source configuration
Agent が見える範囲そのもの: What the Agent can see at all
Preview runtime の更新、または runtime の切り替え: An update to the Preview runtime, or a switch of runtime
10 問すべてを最初から。どちらの runtime で実施したかを記録する: All 10 questions from the start. Record which runtime you ran them on
参照元データの更新・再作成: A refresh or rebuild of the underlying data
期待値を取り直したうえで 10 問すべてを最初から: Retake the expected values, then all 10 questions from the start
別ワークスペースへの移送、または参照先の張り替え: Promotion to another workspace, or rebinding to a different target
同じ設定が別のデータに向く: The same configuration now points at different data
移送先のデータに対して 10 問すべてを最初から: All 10 questions from the start, against the data in the destination
変更なしの定期確認: A periodic check with no change
設定は変わらないが、環境側は変わりうる: The configuration does not change, but the environment can
公開済みの固定スモークセット T03・T07・T08 のみ: Only the fixed published smoke set T03/T07/T08
再評価の 6 つの引き金と、その範囲: The 6 triggers for re-evaluation and their scope
実質的な変更があったときの再評価は、10 問すべての実施です。落ちた問いだけを直: Re-evaluation after a substantive change means running all 10 questions. Fixing only the failed question and rerunning it is not accepted. The fixed smoke set is enough only for a periodic check with no change. The pass condition stays 10/10 as in section 17.11, and a person does the scoring. UNCLEAR counts as FAIL.
やり直しの単位は 10 問: The unit of a redo is 10 questions
18.2 公開説明に書く 5 項目: 18.2 The 5 items a publish description must carry
上の 4 項目のうち、後から効いてくるのは公開説明です。公開説明は利用者に対する: Of the four items above, the publish description is the one that keeps mattering afterwards. It is a promise to the people who use the agent, and in a configuration where an orchestrator or another agent calls it, it also becomes the basis for deciding whether to route a question to this Data Agent. Write what it answers and what it does not, rather than that it is useful.
どの業務領域の問いを扱うか: Which business area the questions belong to
ふるさと納税の寄付・自治体・返礼品と、その関係: Hometown-tax donations, municipalities and gifts, and the relationships between them
代表的な問いの種類。指標と時間範囲を含める: Representative question types, including the metric and the time range
2025 年の静的な件数・金額・順位、2026 年 8 月の観測、関係のたどり方: Static 2025 counts, amounts and ranks, the August 2026 observations, and how relationships are traversed
どのソースを構成し、どの数字がどこ由来かを述べる: State which sources are configured and where each figure comes from
3 ソース。静的な指標は Lakehouse、運用観測は Eventhouse、: 3 sources. Static metrics from the Lakehouse, operational observations from the Eventhouse, relationships from the Ontology
境界と拒否。粒度をまたぐ合算や推論要求を明示する: Boundaries and refusals. State cross-grain sums and inference requests explicitly
静的と観測の合算、集約ビューからの一意件数、寄付から資産や所得を推し量る問い: Summing static and observed data, unique counts from an aggregated view, and questions that infer wealth or income from donations
実データか学習用かを最初に述べる: State up front whether it is real or teaching data
学習用の合成データ。実在の個人・事業者・寄付実績は含まない: Synthetic data for teaching. It contains no real individual, business or donation record
公開説明に必ず含める 5 項目: The 5 items every publish description must include
公開説明は、Data Agent の設定を読めない人が唯一読める契約です。境界を: The publish description is the only contract readable by someone who cannot read the Data Agent's configuration. Publish without stating the boundaries and a question it cannot answer will be read as something broken. Refusal is by design, and conveying that design in advance is what the publish description is for.
境界を書かない公開説明は契約にならない: A publish description without boundaries is not a contract
Copilot の消費は、操作ごとの固定額ではなく、処理されたトークン量に応じた: Copilot consumption is metered as capacity units (CUs) against the tokens processed rather than a flat amount per operation. Input and output are rated differently, and the rates can change. In addition, a query the Data Agent generates and executes is billed separately against the engine item that runs it.
対話や文脈が長いほど消費は増える。Fabric Capacity Metrics: The longer the conversation and its context, the higher the consumption. Measure it under `Copilot in Fabric` in the Fabric Capacity Metrics app. Read the token share and the engine-side execution share separately. This guide prints no rate that can change.
C.2 のゲート 3 と 4 は、公開までの 1 回の通過を決めます。C.5 は: Gates 3 and 4 in C.2 decide a single passage up to publication. C.5 is the operating procedure for updating, republishing and rolling back. C.7 connects the two: it is the minimum structure for running evaluation as a repeating loop rather than as a one-off event. It stays within the Ontology and the Data Agent and does not cover organisation-wide operations.
C.7 はゲートを増やしません。ゲートは C.2 の 4 つのままです。ここで増: C.7 adds no gate. The gates remain the four in C.2. What is added here is only the judgement of when gates 3 and 4 are passed again.
設定・ソース選択・ランタイム・評価データセットを固定し、版を付ける。どの版を評価: Freeze and version the configuration, the source selection, the runtime and the evaluation dataset. An evaluation that cannot later say which version it evaluated is not evidence.
固定した held-out の正解セットを実行する。問いも期待値も、評価のたびに: Run the fixed held-out ground truth. Neither the questions nor the expected values change between runs.
回答本文と実行詳細を見る。エンジン側の記録が見られる場合は、それも合わせて見る。: Look at the answer body and the run details. Where engine-side records are visible, look at those too.
人が確認する。ルート、粒度、境界、拒否の適切さは、人の判断で採点します。: Have a person review it. The route, the grain, the boundary and the appropriateness of a refusal are scored by human judgement.
合格したときにだけ公開・昇格する。合格していない版は先へ進めません。: Publish or promote only on a pass. A version that has not passed does not move forward.
Keep monitoring after publication, and when a trigger fires, return to the loop from the frozen version. The triggers are listed in section 17.12.1.
この輪の正本は、第 17 章の 10 問を人が採点する手順です。ルート選択、粒度: The canonical form of this loop is the human scoring of the ten questions in chapter 17. Route selection, grain, stable IDs, boundaries and the appropriateness of a refusal are decided by human review in this workshop.
公開プレビューには、質問と期待する回答の組を与えて評価を実行する仕組みがあります: The public preview includes a way to run an evaluation from pairs of a question and an expected answer. This guide names no package, class or method and shows no code: they can change, and this workshop does not run them. Only the position is settled here.
手作業の 10 問（本ワークショップの正本）: The manual 10 questions (canonical for this workshop)
ルート、粒度、安定 ID、境界、拒否の適切さ: Route, grain, stable IDs, boundaries, appropriateness of a refusal

Calibrate on a separate set scored by people, not the one in chapter 17, and include three kinds of case: a good answer, a bad answer, and a correct refusal. Run the same set several times so the variance in the verdicts is visible. Always read the cases where the verdict disagreed with the human one. Version the critic prompt and its scoring criteria. The level treated as a pass is decided per project, and no figure for it is given in this guide.

D.7.1 Core が追加しない理由: D.7.1 Why Core does not add it
Core では、静的な指標の権威を Lakehouse 1 つに固定しています。: Core pins the authority for static metrics to the Lakehouse alone. Give two sources the ability to answer the same metric and a new question appears: which figure is correct. The routing rules and the declaration of authority would have to be redesigned. And once the design changes, all ten questions in chapter 17 are redone (section 17.12.1). Against the learning goal of the workshop, that extra complexity does not pay. This is a design decision of this workshop, not a product constraint.
D.7.2 追加するときに整える順序: D.7.2 The order to prepare in when you add it
公開されているセマンティックモデルのベストプラクティスに沿った順序です。リンクは: This order follows the published semantic model best practices. The link is in appendix E.
モデル自体を整理して最適化する。使わない列・テーブル・メジャーを外す: Tidy and optimize the model itself. Remove columns, tables and measures that are not used
余分な要素は解釈の候補を増やし、精度と応答時間の両方に効く: Superfluous elements add candidates to interpret and affect both accuracy and response time
AI 向けのデータスキーマを、関係する要素とその依存先だけに絞る: Narrow the AI data schema to the relevant objects and the objects they depend on
似た名前の指標が並ぶと、どれを指したのか決められない: When similarly named metrics sit side by side, which one was meant cannot be settled
よく聞かれる問いと、間違えやすい複雑な問いに検証済みの回答を用意する: Prepare verified answers for the common questions and for the complex ones that are easy to get wrong
同じ問いに毎回同じ答え方をさせる: So the same question is answered the same way every time
Data Agent にモデルを追加し、まず素の状態で試す: Add the model to the Data Agent and try it plain first
どこに追加の指示が要るかは、試さないと分からない: Where extra instructions are needed cannot be known without trying

生成された DAX と実行詳細を読む: Read the generated DAX and the run details
回答が違うとき、どの設定を直すかは DAX を見て決まる: When an answer is wrong, the DAX is what tells you which setting to fix
利用者を巻き込んで検証する。プログラムによる評価は任意で足す: Validate with users. Add programmatic evaluation optionally
自動の確認だけでは、期待とのずれが見つからない: Automated checks alone do not surface the gap against expectations
